email.subject: Quick fix for Dockside Co's site
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I looked at Dockside Co Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors searching for a Harbor Falls plumber have to copy and dial manually instead of tapping to call, and your hours aren't listed, so people can't tell if you're open now and may just call a competitor instead.

Both are quick fixes. I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes local business sites for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
